name: Sahel insurgency
value: Insurgency sustained; no capital newly fallen
summary: Armed men killed 38 villagers near Téra in western Niger on 12 Nov; insurgency sustained; no capital newly fallen
state: Unidentified armed men killed 38 people, including self-defence members and women, in an ambush on villagers travelling to Téra market in Niger's Tillabéri region on 12 Nov, a former local official told AFP (DH/Belga, 13 Nov). JNIM and Islamic State Sahel Province continue to fight state forces and each other across the Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger border zone. Searches on 22 Nov found no fall or blockade of a capital or major city and no mass-casualty attack in a coastal state, so Watch holds.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice, which advises against travel to large parts of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger. Aid workers and contractors in the region face a high risk of attack and kidnapping.
rubric_hit: Sustained insurgency; no capital or major city fallen = Watch

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
